t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The pair of gnomes appear based on complementary colours like blue and yellow or brown and purple. They found that they earned more points to sticking to one colour when faced with a pair.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in pairs of complementary colours so for example you will always see purple and brown together or green and pinkFor me, I found that sticking to one colour based on the points worked for me in gaining alot of points but before deciding you will need to experiment for yourself first which colours earn the most points. So for example, whenever I saw 1x with the purple and brown gnomes i always chose brown but for 5x I chose purple.
